narrative:
Based on your application, the model determined there is an 81% chance you would be a bad credit risk, which is why your loan was denied. This prediction is not a judgment of your character, but an analysis of your financial profile compared to others.

Think of these "what if" scenarios as a roadmap. The model found one specific change that would flip the prediction to "good credit" and get your loan approved. The single most important factor was your credit history. Currently, your record shows "no credits/all paid," which means you have no established borrowing history. The model suggests that if your credit history instead showed that you had taken and paid off other credits, even if some were critical, your application would be approved.

This is the only change needed. Your requested loan amount of 1,082 DM, your 12-month duration, your savings under 100 DM, and your stable employment of 1-4 years were all acceptable as they were. Your age, housing situation, and job type were also not factors in the decision.

The key takeaway is that the model sees a lack of a proven track record as a significant risk. To get approved in the future, you would need to build a credit history. This could involve taking a smaller loan or a credit card, paying it off reliably, and then reapplying. Your current financial situation is otherwise strong, and this single change would likely be enough to secure the loan you need.
